question: Who was the Prime Minister of India when the Third Five-Year Plan was made?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The third five-year plan had set a target of a 5.6 percent growth rate but it could only achieve a 2.5 percent growth. 
 
• The third five-year plan was incorporated in the period from 1961 to 1966 which saw two wars and a draught.
